records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 20 August 2026, when ETH traded near $2,200. ETH is $2,692 today.

[2026-08-20_ETH]  
Video Title: Ethereum: $ETH Accumulation Zone Analysis  🚨📉  
Video ID: VdpEbWXLmsY  
Ethereum (ETH) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
• Current trading price sits at $2,200, a 30‑31% premium over the time‑weighted average price (TWAP) baseline of $1,700.  
• Key SMA structural levels: the 50‑day SMA is near $2,100, while the 200‑day SMA hovers around $1,800, placing ETH in a neutral risk zone (risk levels 1 and 2).  
• Composite risk score indicates a moderate upside bias, with the phase‑detection model exiting deep capitulation and entering a less‑accumulation phase.  
• Social sentiment word‑cloud shows a near‑even split between bullish and bearish narratives, with a slight bearish tilt over the past 7 days.

Macro Quantitative Risk  
• TWAP baseline at $1,700 establishes a risk‑level framework; deviations above this trigger risk level 1, while further upside moves trigger risk level 2.  
• Polynomial regression fair‑value band centers at $3,000, suggesting a potential upside ceiling if the price re‑enters the green zone.  
• Undervaluation residuals are currently negative, indicating ETH is trading below its regression‑derived fair value, while overvaluation residuals remain low.  
• The gravity model confirms a bottom‑finding bias, whereas the base TWAP model better captures tops, aligning with the current rally trajectory.

Downside & Upside Targets  
• Machine‑learning forecast (10‑week horizon): floor at $1,500, base case near $2,100, and bull case up to $2,800.  
• Panic‑drawdown support floor projected at $1,300–$1,400, with a non‑panic floor around $1,500.  
• Macro moving‑average supports: 50‑day SMA at $2,100 and 200‑day SMA at $1,800 serve
